description: Foundation + guarded Firebase + rules + pure libs. Scaffolds the Next.js 15 App-Router strict-TS Tailwind+shadcn+pnpm project, installs the locked dependency set, lays down the full TypeScript data model + Zod schemas, implements the four provable pure libs with unit tests, builds the guarded lazy Firebase layer that stays green with absent creds, writes the security/storage/index rules VERBATIM from design C.9, and stubs the 11 ServiceResult-returning services. This is the spine's foundation (design C.16 steps 1-3) and depends on nothing. Leaves lint/typecheck/build green with empty env.
steps: Scaffold Next.js 15 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, ESLint) with pnpm at the repo root (do not create a worktree). Set tsconfig.json strict:true. Init shadcn/ui (components.json) + Lucide. Theme tokens primary #22c55e, background #09090b.

Add package.json scripts: dev, build (next build), start, lint (next lint), typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test (vitest run), test:rules (emulator). Install deps: zustand, firebase, framer-motion, gsap, canvas-confetti, react-hook-form, zod, @hookform/resolvers, recharts, date-fns, @ducanh2912/next-pwa; devDeps: vitest, @vitejs/plugin-react, jsdom, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, @firebase/rules-unit-testing. Add vitest.config.ts (jsdom env). Wire next.config.ts with @ducanh2912/next-pwa disabled in dev (do not add icons/manifest yet; that is FEAT-006).

Create src/types/ (barrel index.ts + per-domain files) with every entity from design C.3: unions (DayOfWeek, Goal, Experience, Unit, SessionStatus, RpeMode, MuscleGroup, ExerciseCategory, Equipment, ProgressionType) and entities UserProfile, UserSettings (smartRestEnabled, deviceId, progressionConfig; NO preferredUnit), Exercise, ExerciseSet, WorkoutPlan/PlanDay/PlanEntry (toFailure/perSide/durationSeconds/intervalWork+RestSeconds/order), WorkoutSession (summaryApplied, deviceId, schemaVersion), ExerciseSession (REQUIRED non-optional sessionCompleted), SetLog (REQUIRED sessionCompleted + one-of actualReps/durationSeconds, isPr flags), ExerciseHistory, PersonalRecord, ProgressionRecommendation, BodyMeasurement, ProgressPhoto, RecoveryLog, Goal, Achievement, WorkoutNote, TimerState, WeeklySummary, MonthlySummary, SyncOperation. No 'any'. Add src/lib/constants.ts with APP_SCHEMA_VERSION (integer).

Add Zod schemas (src/lib/schemas/*) mirroring design C.13 bounds (reps>=0, weight>=0, RPE 1-10, RIR 0-10, sleep 0-24, 1-5 scales, hydration>=0, measurements>0, enum membership, string lengths) with the SetLog XOR refinement (exactly one of actualReps/durationSeconds). These schemas are single-sourced and reused by converters, forms, and backup import.

Implement pure libs with Vitest unit tests: src/lib/oneRepMax.ts (epley1RM(weightKg,reps)=weightKg*(1+reps/30), reps 1 -> weight), src/lib/units.ts (toDisplay/fromDisplay, factor 2.2046226218, plate-sensible rounding, kg canonical, round-trip stable), src/lib/volume.ts (set=weightKg*reps, duration sets with no actualReps -> 0 mechanical volume, rollups + change %), src/lib/progression.ts (double-progression with the concrete progressionConfig defaults and the six branch rules INCREASE_WEIGHT/INCREASE_REPS/MAINTAIN/REDUCE_WEIGHT/REDUCE_VOLUME/DELOAD + confidence=min(1,comparableSessions/3) + the smart-rest adjustment fn from C.8a; pure, never mutates the plan). Write *.test.ts siblings.

Build the guarded lazy Firebase layer per design C.2: src/lib/firebase/config.ts exports firebaseConfigPresent(), getFirebaseApp(), getFirebaseAuth(), getDb(), getStorageClient() with NO top-level initializeApp(), getters returning null when config absent or on server (typeof window), singleton via getApps()/getApp(), initializeFirestore with persistentLocalCache({tabManager:persistentMultipleTabManager()}) and ignoreUndefinedProperties:true, App Check + Analytics browser-only/env-gated/isSupported()-gated and skipped when keys absent. converters.ts: typed withConverter per collection (Timestamp<->Date, defaulting, schema-version stamping, OMITTING absent optional keys via conditional spread). queries.ts: bounded/ordered/paginated query builders. auth.ts/firestore.ts/storage.ts thin wrappers.

Create .env.local (blank placeholders, already gitignored) and committed .env.local.example listing all six NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* plus optional NEXT_PUBLIC_APPCHECK_SITE_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID and a FIREBASE_APPCHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN dev comment.

Write firestore.rules, storage.rules, firestore.indexes.json, and firebase.json VERBATIM from design C.9: no match /{document=**}; helpers signedIn/owns/stamped/notCompleted/onlySummaryAppliedChanged/parentOpen/validExerciseSession/validSet/validSession/validBody/validRecovery; per-collection matches exactly incl. the summaryApplied-only COMPLETED update toggle, allow delete gated on notCompleted(), and the exercises/sets create-gate via parentOpen()+required sessionCompleted==false. storage.rules splits read (ownership only) from write (ownership + size<10MB + image/* contentType). firestore.indexes.json: sessions(status,completedAt), (startedAt), personalRecords(exerciseId,achievedAt), bodyMeasurements(date).

Stub the 11 services in src/services/* (authService, workoutService, sessionService, exerciseService, progressService, analyticsService, bodyService, recoveryService, goalService, backupService, syncService) returning the ServiceResult<T> discriminated union, each guarding on a non-null client and otherwise returning {ok:false, code:'firebase/not-configured', message:<friendly>} (no throw). Map raw Firebase errors to friendly code/message here.
Run the full verification and fix any failure; commit locally on branch main (no push).
acceptance_criteria: pnpm install && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build all exit 0 with an EMPTY .env.local and no module throws at import (NFR-1, AC-1).
firebaseConfigPresent() returns false under empty env and every Firebase getter returns null without throwing; a Vitest asserts this.
epley1RM equals weightKg*(1+reps/30) within floating-point tolerance (AC-8) and a kg<->lb round-trip is drift-free (AC-12), both asserted by Vitest.
firestore.rules contains no 'allow read, write: if true' and no recursive wildcard match (AC-4); storage.rules splits read/write with image/size checks on write only (AC-5).
A converter unit test shows a duration-based SetLog serializes with a durationSeconds key and NO actualReps key.
Every service returns code 'firebase/not-configured' when config is absent (asserted by Vitest).
verification: pnpm install && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build  (all exit 0, empty env, nothing throws at import)
pnpm vitest run src/lib  (pure-lib + converter + config-guard tests pass, incl. Epley tolerance and kg<->lb round-trip)
pnpm vitest run src/services  (each service returns firebase/not-configured under empty env)
findings:
Foundation complete. All four gates green with EMPTY .env.local: pnpm lint (0 warnings), pnpm typecheck (tsc --noEmit), pnpm build (next build; next-pwa SW generated), and 49 Vitest unit tests pass (src/lib + src/services).

STACK PINS (locked by pnpm-lock.yaml; do not drift): next 15.1.3, react/react-dom 19.0.0, firebase 11.10.0, zustand 5.0.15, framer-motion 11.18.2, gsap 3.15.0, canvas-confetti 1.9.3, react-hook-form 7.89.0, zod 3.25.76 (NOTE: zod v3 API, not v4), @hookform/resolvers 3.x, recharts 2.15.4, date-fns 4.1.0, @ducanh2912/next-pwa 10.2.9, lucide-react 0.469. Dev: vitest 2.1.9, @vitejs/plugin-react, jsdom 25, @testing-library/react 16 + jest-dom 6, @firebase/rules-unit-testing 4. shadcn deps added: class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge, tailwindcss-animate.

PNPM 12 QUIRK: native build scripts are gated. pnpm-workspace.yaml carries an `allowBuilds:` map (esbuild/sharp/protobufjs/@firebase/util/unrs-resolver = true) — committed; required for esbuild/vitest to work. If you add deps needing postinstall, extend that map.

SCAFFOLD: App Router, strict TS (tsconfig paths '@/*' -> src/*). Tailwind dark-first; CSS vars in src/app/globals.css (primary #22c55e = hsl 142 71% 45%, background #09090b = hsl 240 10% 3.9%). ESLint via .eslintrc.json (eslint-config-next) with no-unused-vars argsIgnorePattern '^_' and SW artifacts ignored; `next lint`. next.config.ts wraps @ducanh2912/next-pwa, DISABLED in dev, dest public/. Generated public/sw.js + workbox-*.js and *.tsbuildinfo are gitignored.

TYPES (src/types, barrel index.ts): all C.3 entities. NAMING COLLISION RESOLVED — the profile-goal union is exported as `Goal` (enums.ts); the goals/{id} entity is exported as `GoalRecord` (goal.ts), because a project can export only one `Goal`. Use `GoalRecord` for the goal-tracking doc everywhere. ServiceResult<T> + FIREBASE_NOT_CONFIGURED const live in src/types/service.ts. APP_SCHEMA_VERSION=1 in src/lib/constants.ts.

ZOD (src/lib/schemas, barrel index.ts): per-domain schemas mirror C.13 bounds. setLogSchema has the actualReps/durationSeconds XOR .refine. enums.ts exports goalSchema (union); goal.ts exports goalSchemaZ (the GoalRecord doc) to avoid name clash. Reuse these in forms/converters/backup import (single-sourced).

PURE LIBS (tested): oneRepMax.epley1RM (reps<=1 returns weight, else w*(1+reps/30)); units.ts toDisplay/fromDisplay (LB_PER_KG=2.2046226218, KG_PER_LB; kg canonical, kg rounds 0.5, lb rounds 1, fromDisplay does NOT round the stored kg so round-trip is drift-free); volume.ts setVolumeKg (duration set w/ no actualReps => 0), totalVolumeKg, emptyMuscleVolume, rollupMuscleVolume, changePct (0 baseline guard); progression.ts recommendProgression (6 branches + confidence=min(1,comparable/3)), DEFAULT_PROGRESSION_CONFIG, smartRestSeconds (C.8a). All pure; progression inputs are the SessionTopSet[] shape (most-recent-first) + comparableSessions + recoveryScore + e1rmTrendFlat — later session/analytics code must compute those and feed them in.

GUARDED FIREBASE (src/lib/firebase): config.ts is the ONLY place that initializes. firebaseConfigPresent(), getFirebaseApp/Auth/Db/StorageClient() all return null when 6 env vars absent OR typeof window==='undefined' (so RSC never pulls client SDK). getDb() uses initializeFirestore with persistentLocalCache({tabManager:persistentMultipleTabManager()}) + ignoreUndefinedProperties:true, memoized. App Check + Analytics are dynamic-import, browser-only, env-gated, isSupported()-gated. getAnalyticsClient() is async. converters.ts: Timestamp<->Date, OMIT absent optionals via present() helper (never field:null), schemaVersion stamped on sessions. Converters exist for UserProfile/WorkoutSession/ExerciseSession/SetLog/BodyMeasurement/RecoveryLog — ADD the remaining converters (plans, PRs, exerciseHistory, goals, achievements, notes, summaries, progressPhotos) in their features following the same present()/conditional-spread pattern. queries.ts: completedSessionsQuery/sessionsInRangeQuery/personalRecordsForExerciseQuery/bodyMeasurementsTrendQuery. firestore.ts helpers: userRootRef, userCollection, userDoc, profileDataRef (users/{uid}/profile/data), settingsRef (users/{uid}/settings/preferences). auth.ts/storage.ts thin wrappers.

SERVICES (src/services, barrel index.ts): 11 stubs each guard on non-null client and return notConfigured() ({ok:false,code:'firebase/not-configured'}) otherwise. Shared helpers in serviceResult.ts: ok()/fail()/notConfigured()/mapError() — mapError maps FirebaseError.code to friendly text (extend the FRIENDLY map as new error codes surface). Keep ALL Firestore access inside services; UI must never import firebase/firestore directly. Implement real logic by replacing each stub body, keeping the ServiceResult contract and the client-null guard.

RULES/CONFIG: firestore.rules + storage.rules transcribed VERBATIM from C.9 (no match /{document=**}, no `if true`; validSet/validSession/validBody/validRecovery/validExerciseSession/parentOpen/onlySummaryAppliedChanged; summaryApplied false->true toggle via updateDoc merge; COMPLETED delete blocked; subcollection create gated on parentOpen() + required sessionCompleted==false). firestore.indexes.json: sessions(status,completedAt),(startedAt); personalRecords(exerciseId,achievedAt); bodyMeasurements(date). firebase.json wires rules+indexes+storage+emulators.

TESTS: `pnpm test` = vitest run (excludes tests/rules). `pnpm test:rules` uses vitest.rules.config.ts against tests/rules/*.test.ts via @firebase/rules-unit-testing on emulator ports (firestore 8080). The rules suite is SKELETON + emulator-gated: initializeTestEnvironment is wrapped so when the emulator is ABSENT (as in this sandbox) each test early-returns (pending). STATUS: C.14 emulator rules assertions (a-g) are NOT yet verified against a live emulator — 'needs verification during implementation'. Flesh out tests/rules and run with `firebase emulators:start` when available. Vitest alias '@'->./src set in vitest.config.ts; setup file vitest.setup.ts loads jest-dom.

ENV: .env.local (gitignored, blank placeholders) + committed .env.local.example (6 required NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* + optional NEXT_PUBLIC_APPCHECK_SITE_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID + App Check debug-token comment).

FALLBACK ROUTES: src/app/not-configured and src/app/offline are minimal static server components; AuthGuard (FEAT-004) should render the not-configured copy inline and treat /not-configured only as a deep-link fallback.

NOT DONE HERE (later features): seed data (src/data/*), stores (src/store/*), hooks, components, auth flows/AuthGuard, PWA manifest/icons, the full sync layer, backup logic, remaining converters/services bodies.
